newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - June 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - June 5.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Cabinet agrees increase in producer price of cotton for 1997/98 season to 200 CFA francs/kilo from 180 CFA for first quality seed cotton, forecasts production of at least 280,000 tonnes.
- President Henri Konan Bedie appeals to students to end strike and return to lectures.
- Civil servants found absent during spot checks have their salaries suspended.

- Swiss ABB AG has presented the most competitive bid for building Abidjan's third thermal power station and negotiations will now take place on details of the deal, Tidjane Thiam, director-general of the National Office of Technical Studies and Development, told a news conference.
- Bids opened for privatisation of sugar firm SODESUCRE in two lots. (1$=580 CFA) -- Abidjan newsroom +225 21 90 90
